name: @local/dsh-codewiki
description: CodeWiki for DeepSeek Harness: cw CLI + whole-repo wiki compilation pipeline with a sidebar panel. Two channels: (1) the in-plugin Node pipeline (default, no Python runtime needed) absorbing FSoft-AI4Code/CodeWiki's AST symbol extraction + LLM clustering, agentic tool-loop writing and symbol-level incremental updates via tree-sitter WASM; (2) an optional native engine channel (nativeEngine, off by default) that drives the upstream FSoft Python engine as a subprocess, which requires a local Python 3.10+ venv with closed deps. Default model workbuddy/hy3 192k, large tier volces-ark/glm-5.3-flash 512k, zero subagents, single-project serial.
